title: Test drive follow-up
description: Follow up after a test drive on WhatsApp with a quote link and a salesperson contact. Marketing template for car dealerships.
notes: Send within 24 hours. Ask how it felt before pitching; one question beats a hard sell.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, thanks for taking the {{model}} for a spin! What did you think? If you want, I can prepare a personalized quote with financing options.
